g.text: Terminal quality after same-goal route choice
Development placements in two parent scenes · all actions charged to the common budget of 256
Each marker shows a measured terminal result. Paired markers are offset vertically for readability.
J = correctly mapped free-space fraction × whole-scene F1. Runs without a metric are kept in the CSV.
